decision.rationale: Use one same-model resilient confirmation candidate because the prior failure cost USD 0 and occurred before a provider response; remove nonessential parameters and permit compatible provider capacity without weakening structured output or deterministic authority.
limitations: No review-007 provider inference occurred, so reviewer quality and live route stability remain unknown.
Endpoint metadata can drift and must be refreshed within 24 hours before execution.
The higher ceiling protects completion but is not a quality criterion or target spend.
The decision dataset remains unfrozen and no evidence-sufficiency implementation is selected.
